title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text: D. whereas the EU has daunting investment needs, including for an additional annual investment of EUR800 billion that the Draghi report deems necessary to boost Europe’s competitiveness and an additional EUR800 billion sought for further defence spending under the ReArm Europe Plan/Readiness 2030; whereas an additional annual investment of EUR 122.2 billion is required to meet circular economy, water, pollution prevention and biodiversity targets; whereas investment efforts cannot rely exclusively on public spending and therefore require mechanisms that can spur and attract private investment;
